latest_release.body:
## What's new?
* Add support for LFM3 and LFM3-VL by @xenova in https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/pull/1821
* test: stabilize Whisper, Idefics3, and tokenizer CI timeouts by @nico-martin in https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/pull/1808
* Expose getSupportedDevices() under env.backends.onnx by @Amarnath10i in https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/pull/1753
* Fix negative integer random seeds by @original4422 in https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/pull/1798
* fix: external data download failure no longer hangs from_pretrained by @iamdgarcia in https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/pull/1804

## New contributors
* @Amarnath10i made their first contribution in https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/pull/1753
* @original4422 made their first contribution in https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/pull/1798
* @iamdgarcia made their first contribution in https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/pull/1804

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/compare/4.3.1...4.3.2
